steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ with username admin and password typed exactly as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (it auto-fills; do not spell it out). Then open the project 'Bench Project', go to its work packages list, and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:'. Do not modify anything.

02-create: In project Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text {{runid}} (e.g. 'Created for run {{runid}}'). Save it. Then report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (the #number shown) and the page URL.

03-open: Open work package {{02-create.work_package_number_displayed}} (subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in project Bench Project. Set the assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' — use the assignee autocomplete and actually pick the 'Bench Assignee' option from the dropdown so it's saved (verify the field shows Bench Assignee after). Also set its status to 'In progress' and its finish date to 2026-12-31 (these are in-place editable fields that save automatically). Verify all three on the page and report the displayed values for assignee, status, and finish date.

04-add: On work package {{02-create.work_package_number_displayed}} in Bench Project, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Tracking run {{runid}}.') and save it. Then reload the page and verify the comment appears in the activity/comments area; report the comment text as displayed and also re-confirm on the page the assignee, status, finish date, subject and displayed #ID.
